pre.speaker: narrator
pre.text: Dust on the plain: an imperial army in full rout, with Zhang Jiao's host on its heels. In the middle of the flight rides Dong Zhuo of Hedong, and he is losing.

pre.speaker: dong-zhuo
pre.text: Out of my way, whoever you are! I am riding west and I am not stopping.

pre.speaker: guan-yu
pre.text: He will not stop for us, brother. The Marshal's men are strung out behind him.

pre.speaker: liu-bei
pre.text: Then we hit their flank from the ridge. Keep the rebels off him, and if the Marshal comes within reach, take him.

post.speaker: narrator
post.text: The rebel host breaks on the plain and streams back toward Guangzong. Dong Zhuo reins in at last, far to the west.

post.speaker: dong-zhuo
post.text: And what office do you hold? None? A volunteer. I see.

post.speaker: zhang-fei
post.text: We saved his life and he asks for our rank. Brother, let me go back and talk to him.

post.speaker: liu-bei
post.text: Leave it. Some of his stragglers will follow a man who stopped for them. That is thanks enough.
